title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: a terminal failure after issuing the model request must record every category the request carried, but the per-category record defines only “produced findings” or “produced none.” When the model request fails or its response is unavailable, neither outcome is knowable. Define an explicit incomplete/unknown outcome and its surfaces, or state that these failures record only which categories were reached without claiming a finding result; otherwise implementation must invent the contract.
